_about: ECB PC ads (Microsoft Store builds of the ECB mobile games). Public file, no secrets. Edited by Freya.

cards._about: Cards between games and for a free hint. ad = an offer id to always show that one, or mix = pick by weight among offers with a QR code. Mix is set to half ECB house ads, half affiliate offers (Chris, 2026-11-21): house weights (testers + launcher) add up to the same as affiliate weights (meshy + higgsfield). The bottom banner takes turns through every offer. Waits are seconds before the card can be closed.
